$comment: Tiered measurement targets for the /pagespeed skill (see the skill's targets.md). tier1 is the public landing page: `/` only redirects in the browser (to /rooms or /due, by the Open the app on setting), so it has nothing of its own to measure. tier2 is the app's three tabs; the installed app opens on /rooms by default. Every page is static. The app pages render from device storage, so these runs measure the EMPTY app; the tasks-loaded state needs localStorage seeded first (see docs/pagespeed-audit.md). Local port 3471 because 3000-3002 are often held by other projects' dev servers on this machine.

tier2.label: rooms
tier2.note: the Folders tab, and every folder and task screen (/rooms?id=...)
